item.title: Tata Sons files draft papers for IPO with regulator
item.description: The holding company of the Tata Group filed draft red herring prospectus documents with the market regulator on Tuesday, kicking off what is expected to be one of the largest Indian listings in years.

item.title: RBI holds repo rate steady at October policy review
item.description: The monetary policy committee voted to maintain the benchmark lending rate, citing sticky food inflation and the need to see sustained disinflation.

item.title: What is an IPO? An explainer for new investors
item.description: An initial public offering is the process by which a private company sells shares to the public for the first time. This explainer walks through the mechanics and what changes for the business afterwards.
